integrity: Analytical proof of finite exact formula, thermodynamic limit, factorial finite-size bound, monotonicity and singular slow-time limit; exact finite-state comparisons and numerical quadrature are supporting checks. No external scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One pendant per site of an open path or infinite decorated line; positive constant Poisson rates for spine and pendant edges, respectively; site-resolved pendant occupation only, not complete joint jamming distribution or arbitrary graphs. Historical priority not independently verified.
title: Exact weighted dimer jamming profile on the decorated integer chain
